content: Aba kasala kopwa ana madágina
E Besaleli gaigíyala taalaidi ikabidi, ana kaba kasala vininabeso ana kaigabu manuna imadagi. Ana mamanao be nakae ana papaeva moe ovatayamo panetayataya go, ana tukotuko moe ovatayamo.

Imadagi ikavava, e ana sakusaku aivasi imadagidi matakubuna aivasi goi iyatoidi go, sakusakuyadi be aba kasala alova tayamo goi imadagidi. Iyatoidi ikavava, aba kasalayana goi kopwa paaevaina ikaupatuko.
Ikavava, kopwa ikabi, aba kasala konanina imadagidi. Konaninayadi ame nakae: Silekau ana kaba vadoda, ana sabwero, ana borodisi, ana sisiwo be nakae pokova ana kaba vadoda imadagidi.
Ikavava, e kopwa tuwaina ikabi, ana vátala imadagi, iyatako yeu ana kaba dímila. Ikavava, e vatalayana aba kasala sinaena nauyayanaina goi sidodoi.
E rini aivasi imadagidi, vatalayana matakubuna aivasi goi ikaupatukoidi go, sisowóduwo aba kasalayana toluyena goi aitakeo manudi.
Ikavava, e aba kasala ana kaitakeo gaigíyala aiyuwo ibobóidi. Ikavava, kopwa paaevaina goi ipaimidi.

Ikavava, aitakeoyadi ivaisiudi riniyadi aba kasala toluyena goi, dadavina tayamo, dadavina tayamo, e bei sikaaitakeve. Ego aba kasalayana timba paaevaidi goi imadagi. Go sinaena daakakaina be nakae dibuna goi geya ana kaubodamo.
Nokobaba kopwa níkina manuna ana madágina

E tovaita vevina maniyedi Yauwe ina Kaba Valoboda ana kaba siu goi sipaaisewa. Tauyadi idi saribu kopwa simedi Besaleli sivini. E saribuyadi ikabidi, nokobaba maa kaena kopwa imadagidi. Nokobabayana moe aba níkina.
Aba Kaiyaka ana kali ana madágina
E Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyaka Besaleli ikali. Areko dedevidi ikabidi, Aba Kaiyaka ana kali imadagi. Aliyana youya dadavina ana mamanao moe ova 30.
E kówala ana badabada 20 adi kaba táoya kopwa goi ivataoedi. E sipodi goi rini be aba talagegeta siriba iyatoidi, arekoyadi ivakosainedi.

E yawéyana dadavina goi nakae iguinuwe. Aliyana ana mamanao moe ova 30 go, kówala ana badabada 20 adi kaba táoya kopwa goi ivataoedi go, sipodi goi rini be aba talagegeta siriba iyatoidi, arekoyadi ivakosainedi.
E aliyana koiboga dadavina ana mamanao moe ovayawou ovanima go, kówala ana badabada yawou adi kaba táoya kopwa goi ivataoedi.
E aliyana ana kaba siu goi, moe bomatu dadavina, ana mamanao nakae ovayawou ovanima.
E aba siu dadavina ana mamanao ovavasi panetayataya, dadavina ovavasi panetayataya. Go ana kówala dadavina aito, dadavina aito adi kaba táoya goi ivataoedi. E kowalayadi goi arekoyadi ivakosainedi.
Areko liliudi aliyadi manudi moe dedevidi toidi.
E kowalayadi adi kaba táoya moe kopwa go, adi takudukudu goi siriba paaevaina ikaupatuko. Nakae adi rini liliudi be adi kaba talagegeta moe siriba.

E gíluma ana tokatanaki búyala noyanoyaidi buruu, kalaakovidi toidi be kayakayaidi be nakae areko dedevidi ikabidi, ali ana kaba siu ana taboda kaarekoina igilumi. Go tabodayana ana mamanao moe ovanima ovatayamo go, ana tukotuko ovatayamo aba katugúyala.
Go tabodayana ana kówala madi kaba táoya moe kopwa go, adi kaba talagegeta moe siriba. Nakae kowalayadi sipodi yatadi moe siriba.
E Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyaka ana kaba kokavata be nakae ali ana kaba kokavata liliudi moe kopwa.
Kainum ana moumouAba Kaiyaka ana madágina manuna

E ame kainum ana kakainaki sikabi Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyaka yoyou ana madágina manuna. Ina Kaba Kaiyakayana goi aba vatulúkwana ikaaiyaka. E Livai tubunao alatuwokoidi kainumyadi sikatuyaividi siginidi. Kidi Livai tubunao adi tovakumgo ame paisewayana manuna moe Itamari, tauyana Tonúwala Eroni natuna.
E Kure, ma Yuda,
natuna moe Urai, e tubuna moe Besaleli. Ame tauyana alatuwoko iguinuwe kaga liliuna nakae boi Yauwe ilovinaegu.

Go Besaleliyana ana tovaita moe Akisamaki natuna Oliyavi ma Dani. Go tauyana kainum ana tokatanaki nakae ana tokabitam. Aiyuwoina tauyana gíluma ana tokatanaki moe areko dedevidi be nakae búyala noyanoyaidi buruu, kalaakovidi toidi be kayakayaidi goi.

E vininabeso goura madabokina ana kakainaki Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyaka Kimaasabaina manuna moe kilo ana badabada eita andedi 830. Ego gourayana sisikere Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyaka Kimaasabaina ana lovina goi sisikere.
E vininabeso siriba ana moumou boi koroto adi katuyáiva goi moe kilo ana badabada 2,819. Siribayana siisikere Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyaka Kimaasabaina ana lovina goi sisikere.

Boi koroto tamo tamo neta adi tala 20 nakae ituko, neta sikatuyaividi, e idi vininabeso siriba goi giyaina Yauwe sivinibeso. Siribayana siisikere Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyaka Kimaasabaina ana lovina goi sisikere. Korotoyadi adi badabada moe 603,550.

Siribayana ana moumou kilo ana badabada 2,800 ikabidi, Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyaka Kimasabainayana ana vabodakalova adi kaba táoya be nakae vabodaupa kaarekoina ana kówala adi kaba táoya imadagidi. Aba taoyayadi adi badabada moe 100, tauna adi kaba táoya tamo tamo siriba ana moumou kilo ana badabada tuwenti 28.
Ago siribayana ikesa moe kilo ana badabada 19, e ikabidi, kówala ana kaba talagegeta be ana rini imadagidi be nakae kowalayadi sipodi goi siribayana paaevaina ikaupatukoidi.
E vininabeso kopwa ana moumou moe kilo ana badabada 2,425.
Kopayana ikabi, ame dogoiyadi imadagidi: Yauwe ina Kaba Valoboda totomna ana kówala, aba kasala kopwa ma vatalina be nakae konanina,
ali ana kówala adi kaba táoya, Yauwe ina Kaba Kaiyakayana ana kaba kokavata be nakae aliyana ana kaba kokavata.

footnotes.text: Ma Yuda: Yuda ameko moe dala yoina. Yuda moe Isileli natuna go, Yudayana tubunao adi dala moe yoina Yuda.
